title: How my content engine works
subtitle: Click any node to see what it does, why it's there, and how I'd build it for you.

panel.headline: Where every post starts
panel.body_html: Each idea is a ClickUp task in the Ideas list with a status field. Promoting the status to approved fires the n8n webhook that wakes the engine. One source, no duplicates.
common_mistakes: Letting ideas live in 3 places at once
No status field — nothing to trigger on
Treating ClickUp as a CMS instead of a queue

panel.headline: Brief becomes a context blob
panel.body_html: n8n fans the brief out to: prior post lookup, audience snapshot, brand voice page, recent comments. Returns a single context blob the generator can reason over.
common_mistakes: No retry on slow Firecrawl calls

panel.headline: Pull current data
panel.body_html: Firecrawl + Anthropic web search find stats, examples, and counter-examples the post will cite. Results scored by source weight — primary sources beat aggregators.

panel.headline: Where copy is written
panel.body_html: Claude Sonnet 4.6 via the Railway proxy. The prompt lives in a ClickUp page so editing it never requires a deploy. Generates 5 hooks, the body, and a CTA.
common_mistakes: Skipping the QA pass before storing
Using the wrong model tier for the job

panel.headline: Quality gate before storage
panel.body_html: A second Claude pass scores the draft on 9 dimensions (claim density, source proof, hook strength, etc). Below threshold → loops back to the generator with the failed dimensions as feedback.

panel.headline: Single source of truth
panel.body_html: Drafts, hook variants, QA scores, and post metadata land in posts with version pointers. Everything downstream reads from here — never from ClickUp.
common_mistakes: Storing copy in ClickUp custom fields
Mixing draft + published in one row

panel.headline: I read it before it ships
panel.body_html: A ClickUp task fires for me with the draft, hook options, and the QA report. I pick the hook and approve — or kick it back. The engine never auto-publishes without me.

panel.headline: Pace, don't dump
panel.body_html: An n8n schedule trigger picks the next approved post per cadence rules (3h gap, 4/day cap, skip-25%). Prevents the LinkedIn algo from throttling.
common_mistakes: No skip rule for low-quality days

panel.headline: Out the door
panel.body_html: UniPile API pushes the post under my real LinkedIn session. Post URN is captured for downstream comment + reply monitoring.

panel.headline: The lead-magnet trigger
panel.body_html: UniPile webhook fires when someone comments. n8n checks the comment text, filters out my own replies, and queues a DM with the matching lead magnet link.

panel.headline: Right magnet, right person
panel.body_html: The DM links to a lead magnet matched to the post's topic. Tracked by prospect_id so I see who opened, scrolled, and converted.
common_mistakes: One generic LM for every post

panel.headline: Re-engage by email
panel.body_html: When a LM viewer drops an email, Resend kicks off a 5-touch nurture. Each touch references their actual viewing behavior — no generic drip.
